passage: Urban planners face significant challenges as cities continue to expand. Increasing populations place pressure on transportation systems, housing availability, and environmental resources. To address these issues, many cities are investing in sustainable development strategies such as public transportation, renewable energy, and green spaces. Supporters argue that sustainable planning improves quality of life while reducing environmental harm. However, critics note that implementing these policies can be expensive and politically difficult. Despite these challenges, many experts believe sustainable development is necessary for the long-term success of modern cities.
